name: Offline Report Lab

run.inputs: Locally constructed scenarios, pinned isolated native helpers and pinned page/extension source.

networkIsolation.transport: Envelope builders stop at the encoder boundary. Captured inputs are replayed through the isolated encoder with no sender present.
networkIsolation.scope: Process-local API guard, deny-by-default fixture imports, and restricted VM contexts; no OS firewall changes.

cases.label: Clean synthetic race frame
cases.interpretation: Original native compare/accumulator/export helpers applied to controlled local fixture data.
limitations: Only eight tiny isolated native helper bodies are instantiated; the full game is never loaded.
Contexts, session identifiers and one watched-region descriptor are synthetic, not production game state.
Envelope-builder cases stop before encoding: inputs are captured locally and the replacement returns zero. Optional encoder replay is a separate case.
Captures are pre-encoding native structures, not wire packets or evidence of server receipt or sanctions.
These fixtures do not establish extension compatibility, detection thresholds or a complete race-report pipeline.

cases.label: Actual native encoder: synthetic race report

captures.description: Actual original native encoder output from a synthetic offline envelope. Retained locally; no sender or live session exists.

cases.interpretation: The original encoder ran with seven original leaf helpers linked and produced this local binary frame; JavaScript independently checked its CRC.
limitations: The actual bounded encoder runs with seven original leaf helpers linked; individual paths may not invoke every helper. No full game or transport is instantiated.
Inputs are the two known synthetic native-envelope snapshots from the offline native scenarios.
These report branches contain inline values, so no original game data, external pointers or passive data segments are supplied.
Encoded bytes stay in local fixture memory and the generated report. No socket, sender callback or network capability exists.
Successful encoding and CRC verification do not establish server acceptance, account decisions or compatibility with other message schemas.

evidence.method: Exact selected native function WAT bodies copied from pinned current build. Existing isolated WABT contexts replace direct dependencies with typed imports, retain original globals/types and shared-memory declaration, and contain no game data or live transport implementation.
evidence.importPolicy: Exact pinned import sets only; no transport, network, process, filesystem or clock access is supplied to native imports.

evidence.method: Eight exact selected original native WAT bodies in separately compiled isolated contexts. Seven real leaf exports satisfy the original encoder direct calls. Memory is the only external capability. No game instance, data segment, socket or transport implementation is included.
evidence.crcCheck: Independent JavaScript reflected CRC-32; altered-copy negative check.
